_note: Two Baidu road-level views of the new terminal — the approach road and the kerbside frontage — now accompany the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

lhw-baidu-1.webp.zh: 沿进场道路驶向兰州中川机场：白色波浪形屋顶的航站楼横在道路尽头，上方挂着蓝底白字的路牌。
lhw-baidu-1.webp.en: Driving along the approach road toward Lanzhou Zhongchuan — the white wave-shaped terminal roof ahead beneath blue overhead signs.

lhw-baidu-2.webp.zh: 兰州中川机场航站楼正面：层叠的白色屋面自拱形立柱展开，屋脊上立着红色「兰州」二字，车道上有车流与行人。
lhw-baidu-2.webp.en: The frontage of Lanzhou Zhongchuan's terminal — layered white roofs springing from arched columns, red '兰州' characters on the ridge and traffic at the kerb.

lhw-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，兰州中川国际机场（LHW）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
lhw-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Lanzhou Zhongchuan International Airport (LHW) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
